description: EIA Cleaned Hourly Electricity Demand Conda Environment is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tyler H. Ruggles, David J. Farnham (Carnegie Institution for Science). We are preserving the exact Conda computing environment used for the `EIA Cleaned Hourly Electricity Demand Data` project. See the resulting data and the code used to clean the data. This Conda environment `data_cleaning_env_OSX_10.14.tar.gz` was created using Mac OSX 10.14.6 and is only expected to run on recent versions of Mac OSX. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
